meta_description: Henderson's Professional Decorators in Newcastle. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorative finishes. Free quotes. Call 07837 422747.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior decoration done right. We transform homes across Newcastle with expert craftsmanship and attention to detail.
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior refresh, we handle every aspect of professional painting and wallpapering.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full interior redecoration including feature walls, ceiling finishing, and trim work. We protect your furniture and keep disruption to a minimum throughout the project.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior finishes for walls, woodwork, and doors. We use trade-grade paints designed to withstand Newcastle weather and last for years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precision wallpapering and bespoke feature wall installation. Our team handles everything from pattern matching to awkward corners with skill and care.

services.title: Textured Coatings & Finishes
services.desc: Applied textured finishes, Artex removal and replacement, and specialty coating applications. Transform tired walls with contemporary or classic texture options.

services.title: Wood & Door Finishing
services.desc: Expert painting and staining of doors, skirting boards, architraves, and wooden features. We prep and finish wood properly to ensure a long-lasting, professional result.

services.title: Commercial Redecoration
services.desc: Professional painting for offices, retail units, and commercial spaces. We work flexibly around your business hours and maintain a clean, professional site.

about_pullquote: I started this business to do decoration properly—no shortcuts, no mess.
about_para_1: Henderson's Professional Decorators was founded in 2012 by Stuart Henderson, a master decorator with over 15 years' experience in residential and commercial painting. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a respected team serving Newcastle and the surrounding areas, having completed over 1,200 projects with a consistent reputation for precision and reliability.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we treat every job—whether a single bedroom or a full commercial refit—with the same meticulous attention. We arrive on time, protect your home or business properly, and leave the site clean. Most of our new work comes from personal recommendations and repeat customers.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Stuart and the lads decorated our lounge and hallway during lockdown. Really tidy workers, finished on time, and the finish is excellent. The colour we chose looked dodgy on the chart but Stuart talked us through it and we're really pleased. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen and bathroom done. Fair prices, turned up when they said they would, and the standard of work is first-class. No mess left behind either. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Booked Henderson's for an exterior repaint on a difficult Victorian property. They managed the scaffolding, weather delays, and tight spaces without fussing. Paint job looks stunning and will last years. Real professionals.
reviews.author: David P.
